name: ADA QRIS Profile (TAPP-linked)
abstract: Profile for an ADA metadata document describing Quantitative Reflectance Imaging System products generated under a registered qrisTAPP procedure. Adds the QRIS analysis detail on the schema:Dataset root and pins prov:used to the qrisTAPP definition, on top of the ADA QRIS component-type constraints.
